body:
Just a few hours left before...
| Friend – I wish I had better news for you with early voting set to begin in less than a month here in Texas for the final seat needed to take back the House.
---
But this is the reality we’re facing...
---
**_The latest polls now show Pelosi within the _*margin of error*_ of maintaining her radical majority._**
---

clean_body: We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. | | Derek -- I am writing to ask you to split a $10 contribution to the Democratic National Committee and Mandela Barnes's campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign. Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. A recent Marquette poll shows Mandela down by one point, and he is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him. So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline tonight. He’s funding his campaign the right way -- from lots of people making small donations. That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask: At this moment in American history -- in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, and the existential threat of climate change -- it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country. We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country. Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate. First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people. But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can have the votes to continue passing meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face. Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time: We are engaged in many struggles right now. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few. But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country. That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today. In solidarity, Bernie Bernie Sanders U.S. Senator, Vermont The DNC's 2022 Congressional Split Series helps fundraise for and raise awareness around down-ballot Democrats in some of the most important races across the country. When you make a split donation to the DNC, your donation will not only benefit folks on the ballot this cycle -- it will also help create the lasting Democratic infrastructure Democrats need to win up and down the ballot in years to come. Peter,
We know it’s getting late, but we want to make sure you saw Pramila’s message earlier. **There’s just a few hours left before our end-of-quarter deadline, and we’re doing everything we can to raise $350,000 by midnight.**
[**Can you take 2 minutes to read this message from Pramila, and then chip in to help us reach our goal? Your donation counts now more than ever, so any amount at all makes a difference.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18520?refcode=em20220930-1670&t=1&akid=1670%2E420207%2ETOMlRi)

Thank you,
Team Jayapal
\---------- _Forwarded message_ \----------
_From:**Pramila Jayapal**_
_Date: Friday, September 30, 2022_
_Subject: A personal request_
_To: Peter_
Peter,
I talked to my team this morning and they told me we’re just about $5,000 shy of our end-of-quarter goal – so I wanted to reach out personally to make a request.
**We have to reach this goal, Peter – so I can continue to lead the fights for Medicare for All, abolishing the filibuster, protecting reproductive rights, and so much more.**
As I said, right now we’re just $5,000 short of our goal to raise $30,000 by the time our financial quarter closes at midnight tonight. **If we do that, we’ll hit an incredible $350,000 raised this quarter – that’s a game-changing amount for us.**
Peter, I’ll be honest, I am a little worried we won’t reach our goal, but I have faith in our grassroots movement. [**That’s why I’m hoping I can count on your support one final time this quarter. Will you chip in whatever you can before midnight and help us reach $350,000?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18520?refcode=em20220930-1670&t=3&akid=1670%2E420207%2ETOMlRi)
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18520?refcode=em20220930-1670&t=4&akid=1670%2E420207%2ETOMlRi)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18520?refcode=em20220930-1670&t=23&akid=1670%2E420207%2ETOMlRi)**
**We all know how important this midterm election is,** and we need progressives to be in the best possible position come November 8th. Strong fundraising allows us to run the best possible campaign, while also supporting other trailblazing progressives all over the country.
**It’s your support that powers our movement and allows me to stay in Congress term after term so I can fight for you.** I take that responsibility very seriously, which is why I know how important it is that we raise that final $5,000 today.
[**I know that you’re one of my most engaged supporters, Peter, so I’m asking you personally now – can you rush a donation of $3 or any amount to support me one last time before our quarter ends at midnight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18520?refcode=em20220930-1670&t=24&akid=1670%2E420207%2ETOMlRi)
In solidarity,
Pramila

I'm quickly reaching out one last time before our deadline at midnight Peter,

I'm quickly reaching out one last time ahead of our final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline because we still haven't reached our $125,000 goal.

_The Hill_ has called my race one of seven seats most likely to determine control of the House. That's why Republicans are laser-focused on flipping this seat red. They're pouring millions into our district to attack me and prop up my extreme, anti-choice Republican opponent.

Every election is a choice. As my dad used to say, “Don’t compare me to the Almighty. Compare me to the alternative.” Well Derek, the choice couldn’t be clearer: On choice, Democrats want to codify _Roe_ and Republicans want a national ban on abortion. Not only that, Democrats are working every day to build a better America, passing historic legislation like the _Inflation Reduction Act_ and the _American Rescue Plan_ to help lower costs _\-- all without a single GOP vote._ Take a look at congressional Republicans. What’s their platform? MAGA Republicans don’t just threaten our personal rights and economic security, they threaten our very democracy. They want to undo everything we’ve done. **All that we've fought so hard for is on the ballot in just 39 days. With the final end-of-quarter deadline before the midterms just hours away, I’m coming to you directly: Will you make your first $7 donation of the year to the DNC before midnight?**

As my dad used to say, “Don’t compare me to the Almighty. Compare me to the alternative.” Well Derek, the choice couldn’t be clearer: On choice, Democrats want to codify Roe and Republicans want a national ban on abortion. Not only that, Democrats are working every day to build a better America, passing historic legislation like the Inflation Reduction Act and the American Rescue Plan to help lower costs \-- all without a single GOP vote. Take a look at congressional Republicans. What’s their platform? MAGA Republicans don’t just threaten our personal rights and economic security, they threaten our very democracy. They want to undo everything we’ve done. All that we've fought so hard for is on the ballot in just 39 days. With the final end-of-quarter deadline before the midterms just hours away, I’m coming to you directly: Will you make your first $7 donation of the year to the DNC before midnight? Whether or not we’re able to build on the progress we’ve made depends on our ability to defend our Democratic majorities and elect more Democrats at all levels of government. We have to organize, we have to mobilize, and we have to get out the vote. We have got to remember who we are: We are the United States of America. There’s not a thing in the world that we cannot do when we set our minds to it. Nothing, nothing, nothing. Thank you again for your support, Joe Joseph R. body:
CNN says we’re one of the most likely Democrats to flip a seat, and Nate Silver’s election projections agree.
#
Friends -
Mandela Barnes here, humbly asking if you can please make your first online contribution before our September FEC fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.
We have received a lot of individual donations ahead of tonight’s FEC deadline, and that support means the world to me.
But this FEC deadline requires more.
CNN says we’re one of the most likely Democrats to flip a seat, and Nate Silver’s election projections agree.
That’s why our opponents — Ron Johnson and Mitch McConnell’s dark-money groups — are flooding Wisconsin with millions in attack ads. They're outspending us by a significant amount, and we can't risk losing any more ground in this race.
So this FEC deadline matters. A lot. Right after it ends, we’ll make some big budget decisions, ones that could determine the outcome of this race.
So please, I am humbly asking:
[**Can I count on you to use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, to our campaign to defeat Ron Johnson and flip this Senate seat? Please, do it before our FEC fundraising deadline ends at midnight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-sep22.TJJIPs&refcode=em220930-1-acq-p4-sp9&t=1&akid=3375%2E196590%2EuM1Jk_)

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, I want a chance to meet each of you! On Sunday, October 23, 2022, I'll be hosting the first of three free special virtual meet & greet sessions just for you!

[RSVP Sunday, October 23, 2022, 7 p.m. EST](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=da59b60833&e=a49cb82bb3)

**This is your chance!**

Bring your questions, concerns, and get ready to spend a little time with me right before the midterm elections! Share. Tell a friend. Register now! Space is limited. See you soon!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=e45338e8e0&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=067a744be6&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=413137f2c1&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

body:
Fellow Conservative:

The stakes in the upcoming mid-term elections could not be higher, and we are witnessing one of the best political environments for Republicans in a long time.
Now is the time for us to be bold and support as many strong, viable conservative candidates as we possibly can.
RINOs won't do. They do more harm than good. We need rock-solid, fighting conservatives who will keep their word and fight for our freedoms in Washington.
That's why we are supporting twelve - yes, TWELVE - additional candidates today.

▶︎ Mike Collins (GA-10)▶︎ Kelly Cooper (AZ-04)
▶︎ Eli Crane (AZ-02)
▶︎ Joe Kent (WA-03)
▶︎ Karoline Leavitt (NH-01)
▶︎ Max Miller (OH-07)
▶︎ Scotty Moore (FL-09)
▶︎ Sarah Palin (AK-At Large)
▶︎ Neil Parrott (MD-06)
▶︎ Sam Peters (NV-04)
▶︎ Keith Self (TX-03)
▶︎ Sandy Smith (NC-01)
Please support these outstanding leaders right now.
You can donate to each candidate through HFF, and we will transfer 100% of your contributions directly to their campaigns.
Alternatively, you can donate to HFF's general account, and we will use the funds to promote all of our candidates.
As you know, the House Freedom Fund donates the maximum amount allowed by law from our PAC to these candidates, and then we spend as much as we can getting freedom-loving Americans across the nation to donate directly to their campaigns.
Our grassroots model allows us to bundle large sums for our candidates that make the difference in their campaigns.
We are very excited about the opportunity we have to send a large group of conservatives to Washington who will join the House Freedom Caucus and work together to stop the Left and the GOP Establishment from further destroying our country.
But we can't do it without your help.
So please take action now and give as generously as you can so we can push these candidates on to victory.
Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future.

Sincerely,

Ray Yonkura
Executive Director
House Freedom Fund

Hello Friend,

The COVID pandemic showed the fragility of our freedom.

The government forced citizens to wear masks and get experimental vaccines. They locked the economy down to _" flatten the curve."_ The government even colluded with Big Tech to suppress our speech.

Those who didn't comply with the mask or vaccine mandates were harassed, threatened with losing their jobs or silenced online.

This was a problem that needed immediate attention, so Young Americans for Liberty recruited and trained our activists to fight back. And in one state in particular, we've achieved amazing results this year!

But with your support, we can make liberty win in battleground states across the country.

[_**That 's why I've set a goal to connect with 500 new supporters this month, to advance liberty. Can you show YAL your support with a donation of $10, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt2m6sda6suj6r0l9t2dt7ino0aphc2rq5nrh3a0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdi61ob5c5h2bs)

**I 'm excited to report that Young Americans for Liberty students and legislators _passed 9 medical freedom bills in New Hampshire this year_! **

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9h06qa8daeblrqlhlaumgp6ie713mu25tlu1dtg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdi61ob5c5h2bs)

YAL's Hazlitt Action program trains and mobilizes YAL students to help pass bills championed by our Hazlitt Coalition of state legislators.

**In New Hampshire, over 60 Hazlitt members led the charge for medical freedom and YAL students knocked on a total of 25,835 doors!**

By focusing on medical freedom and applying pressure to legislators in New Hampshire we were able to force them to move several pieces of legislation to help protect the rights of Granite Staters.

They will never again have to experience a loss of freedom to choose what medicines or vaccines they put in their body, as they did during the pandemic.

**Next year, YAL 's coalition of legislators will be large enough to make over 100 million Americans more free. And YAL students will mobilize to apply grassroots pressure in some of the most important battles for liberty. **

The freedoms restored below could not have been done without generous supporters.

[_**Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, or any amount to YAL today to help support pro-liberty policies. Click here to donate. >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7fu4p64je5sumclpn34cal89gcf1jeid1i5t7o8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdi61ob5c5h2bs)

**HAZLITT ACTION MEDICAL FREEDOM BILLS PASSED**

**House Bill 1455** --Prevents the state of New Hampshire from enforcing any federal law or order that requires a person to receive the COVID-19 vaccine or submit more than one negative COVID-19 test per month.

**House Bill 1495** --Prohibits the state from requiring businesses to require vaccination or documentation related to vaccination status.

**House Bill 1439** --Allows, with limited exceptions, a patient to designate a parent, spouse, family member, or another caregiver to be present while the patient receives care.

**House Bill 1003** --Prohibits health care providers from refusing to provide care or services based on a patient's vaccination status.

**House Bill 1488** --Expands the prohibition against discrimination based on an individual's choice not to participate in the state vaccine registry.

**House Bill 1604** --Requires state medical facilities to grant religious and medical exemptions from vaccination requirements.

**House Bill 1608** --Requires the Department of Health and Human Services to inform the public of the opportunity to withdraw their COVID-19 vaccination status from the state immunization registry.

**House Bill 1466** --Clarifies when a physician may prescribe a drug for off-label use.

**House Bill 1280** --Prohibits a parent's decision to not have their child vaccinated from being used as the grounds to terminate parental rights.

[**_Can you join the fight to protect our children with a gift of $10, $25, $50, or even $100? Click here to show your support today >>>_**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zs67e64lfbe7g3ec5ve50o6jrjq6movr1f1soctg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdi61ob4c3h2bs)

They were removed from the school board...

Parents Union of America stands as a counter-offensive against the powerful, agenda-driven Teachers' Union and the corrupt school boards. But I could use your help.

[_**Your support goes towards unseating corrupt school board members who are indoctrinating our children.**__**This is your chance to fight back!**__**Please donate today and keep our kids safe >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zok71ndro1jotof1ah4a7cm0p2f2v2dg0p84jjsg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdi61ob4c3h2bs)

Our strategy is to target the most populated school districts first and remove the corrupt individuals running them. Then we will expand this model across the U.S. and ignite a cultural shift throughout the country.

**Are you fed up with the corruption and influence of the Teachers ' Union?**

name: Your America
subject: Take the National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6028%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=t6HF87PAuJq6uPaMk6LE%2bw&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86254%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n9yQ1cS0myzCqfvIlLuPEA&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86265%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p2pJtfAACsLmBidi%2bPFJjw&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86265%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p2pJtfAACsLmBidi%2bPFJjw&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: John Gomez  - Campaign Manager
subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 9/30
body:
A Critical Deadline, New Release, and a Huge Endorsement!
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-v/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 9/30/22
Good evening,It's been another big week for Team Chabot. This week, Congressman Chabot was endorsed by the U.S Chamber of Commerce. The campaign also released the truth about Greg Landsman and his defund the police agenda. We also have some highlights from events along the trail!Read on for these updates and more from the trail! Also, please read on to learn more about a critical deadline toward the end of email. **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot and Team Knocking Doors_ Congressman Chabot continues to bring his message directly to voters' doors. This week Congressman Chabot was joined on doors by Ohio Treasurer of State Robert Sprague in Madeira. Along with Treasurer Sprague, Congressman Chabot was joined by some of our great interns who have been assisting with our ground game. Our team continues to break it's own records for numbers of doors knocked in a day! _Chabot Endorsed By US Chamber of Commerce_ On Monday, Congressman Chabot held a small business roundtable to hear the concerns of local business owners at E-Beam Services in Lebanon. Many expressed concerns over the labor shortage, supply chain issues, and inflation. The Congressman then toured E-Beam's impressive facility and learned more about the important work that's being done right here in our district. The event concluded with the US Chamber of Commerce announcing their endorsement of Congressman Chabot for re-election.
_" Rep. Steve Chabot's strong record of leadership and delivering results for the constituents of southwest Ohio are significant," said Ryan Gleason, U.S. Chamber of Commerce Manager, Great Lakes Regional Office. "Congressman Chabot understands the challenges and economic needs facing the workforce and families in Ohio, and he is committed to pro-growth policies and free enterprise solutions that will move our nation forward. The U.S. Chamber is proud to support Rep. Chabot in his re-election."_Read more about the endorsement [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-y/). _Avondale Day_ Last weekend, Congressman Chabot attended Avondale Day. It was great to see so many families and organizations from the neighborhood participating and supporting the community! _Warren County Applefest_ Warren County is home to some of the best festivals in Ohio's First Congressional District. Applefest is easily one of the best of the bunch. Congressman Chabot enjoyed his time meeting folks as they attended the festival! It was a perfect fall day in Warren County! **_New Release - Landsman Relies on Fellow Soft-on-Crime Politicians to Lie About His Defund the Police Record_** _Landsman 's Plan Was Described in the Press as "The Definition of Defunding" the Police_Congressman Chabot's campaign released the following statement on Greg Landsman's latest television ad desperately trying to obscure his record on public safety by hiding behind fellow left-wing politicians who also support soft-on-crime policies."Families in Cincinnati, Hamilton County and Warren County all deserve to be able to walk down the street in their community without fearing violent crime -- and they also deserve the truth about Greg Landsman's support for radical policies to undermine law enforcement," said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. "As homicides and violent crime were on the rise in Cincinnati, Greg Landsman voted to deny law enforcement $1 million in badly needed resources to keep communities safe and introduced a proposal that WLWT reported constituted 'the definition of defunding' the police.""Now, as he faces accountability for undermining law enforcement and putting our communities at risk for greater violent crime, Landsman is relying on his fellow soft-on-crime politicians to lie about his record," Gomez continued. "Landsman's is trying to obscure the truth about his record by hiding behind fellow politicians who've also supported soft-on-crime policies and accepted endorsements from organizations that support defunding the police.""The simple truth is Greg Landsman can't hide from his record and can't deceive First District voters by hiding behind fellow soft-on-crime politicians," Gomez added. "Keeping families safe and cracking down on violent crime in our region starts with voting to stop Greg Landsman's campaign for Congress.""The men and women of law enforcement put their lives on the line to keep our communities safe," said Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police President Dan Hils. "When Cincinnati faced rising crime, Greg Landsman sided with left-wing radicals and introduced a plan to defund the local police. Landsman even voted to strip a million dollars from law enforcement. Congressman Steve Chabot supports the local police and has been a fierce advocate for first responders. Steve Chabot has our back and will keep our communities safe."Get the facts on Greg Landsman's support for defunding the police and undermining law enforcement [HERE](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-j/).Read more about Congressman Chabot's support from local law enforcement [HERE ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-t/)and [HERE](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-i/). **_New Story: Biden's Mix Record Forces Ohio Democrats into Odd Balancing Act_** This week, a new story from the Associated Press was released discussing our race. Below is an excerpt that I wanted to share with you all; "A recent Landsman campaign event included his releasing a 5-year-old wire-haired dachshund named Jerome in a wiener dog race as Oktoberfest celebrations thronged the city's downtown. Chabot, that same weekend, greeted would-be voters at a smaller, Catholic church-sponsored street festival in the nearby town of Reading, where he was born.'I know a lot of people who are not Democrats and they are definitely going to be voting,' Jean Huneck, a 67-year-old who owns a small mechanical engineering business, said of the new, ostensibly bluer district. Huneck is a registered Democrat but supports Chabot and said the GOP needs big November wins to counter Biden.'I feel like our livelihoods are depending on it,' she said."Read the full story [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-d/) **_This Week 's Blog - "Commitment to America"_**This week's blog post is about the new Republican Commitment to America - _" There's an awful lot in it, but the following are some of the most important commitments. We are committed to pushing for a strong economy. How? Well by reversing the Democrats' policies which have led to inflation and higher and higher costs on virtually everything."_Read the blog post [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-h/). **_Our End of Quarter Goal_** If you've been reading these emails for a while, you know I never ask you to donate. Well, until now. Today is our **CRITICAL** end of quarter. This is one of our last major fundraising deadline before the end of the election cycle. Everything is at stake this November and we need your support to help get our country back on track. Please consider donating to help get us across the finish line. [DONATE NOW](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-k/) Have a great weekend.Yours truly,John GomezCampaign Manager - Chabot for Congress [Donate](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-u/) [Get a Yard Sign](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-b/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-n/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-p/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-z/) [ Share ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-fb-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-e/) [ Tweet ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-tw-tjqjdil-kujkulhluu-s/) [ Forward ](https://stevechabotforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/r-kujkulhluu-961825B2-tjqjdil-l-g) | Chabot for Congress, P.O. "As homicides and violent crime were on the rise in Cincinnati, Greg Landsman voted to deny law enforcement $1 million in badly needed resources to keep communities safe and introduced a proposal that WLWT reported constituted 'the definition of defunding' the police.""Now, as he faces accountability for undermining law enforcement and putting our communities at risk for greater violent crime, Landsman is relying on his fellow soft-on-crime politicians to lie about his record," Gomez continued. "Landsman's is trying to obscure the truth about his record by hiding behind fellow politicians who've also supported soft-on-crime policies and accepted endorsements from organizations that support defunding the police.""The simple truth is Greg Landsman can't hide from his record and can't deceive First District voters by hiding behind fellow soft-on-crime politicians," Gomez added. "Keeping families safe and cracking down on violent crime in our region starts with voting to stop Greg Landsman's campaign for Congress.""The men and women of law enforcement put their lives on the line to keep our communities safe," said Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police President Dan Hils. "When Cincinnati faced rising crime, Greg Landsman sided with left-wing radicals and introduced a plan to defund the local police. Landsman even voted to strip a million dollars from law enforcement. Congressman Steve Chabot supports the local police and has been a fierce advocate for first responders. Steve Chabot has our back and will keep our communities safe."Get the facts on Greg Landsman's support for defunding the police and undermining law enforcement more about Congressman Chabot's support from local law enforcement . Below is an excerpt that I wanted to share with you all; "A recent Landsman campaign event included his releasing a 5-year-old wire-haired dachshund named Jerome in a wiener dog race as Oktoberfest celebrations thronged the city's downtown. Chabot, that same weekend, greeted would-be voters at a smaller, Catholic church-sponsored street festival in the nearby town of Reading, where he was born.'I know a lot of people who are not Democrats and they are definitely going to be voting,' Jean Huneck, a 67-year-old who owns a small mechanical engineering business, said of the new, ostensibly bluer district. Team – I wanted to take a moment to say thank you.

From day one, your grassroots support has been critical to showing the strength of this campaign.

Because of people like you, friend, we've been able to fight back against GOP attacks, reach voters across New Hampshire and build a strong pathway to victory.

But as we enter the last weeks of this race, I'm going to need your continued support more than ever before.

I'm up against Don Bolduc, the most extreme nominee for U.S. Senate that New Hampshire has seen in decades. And with the Senate split 50-50, losing here means ceding control of the Senate majority to Mitch McConnell.
The final stretch of this election is going to be the most challenging – the GOP is going to throw everything they have our way (on top of the over $57 million they're already spending) to elect my far-right opponent and flip the Senate red.

That's why I'm reaching out to ask for your continued support. Granite Staters know better than most that our elections can be decided by a handful of votes – and this year will be no different. If we're going to protect this seat and defend our Senate majority, it's going to take all of us working together.

I won in 2016 by 1,017 votes – that’s a field margin. Every door knock and phone call helped flip this seat – just like every door knock and phone call will help us keep this seat in November. **[If you can spare just an hour of your time, it could make the difference between a red and blue Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51719912/370206920/1504315002?utm_source=mwh-email-20221001&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTBlODE5NS04MDQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6czBynpYMaLPRoRbV__BAYHEisxBTK36_RF7G6LgKUo=&emci=99f74e5d-1540-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=3e0e8195-8041-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=5452893)**

body: Biden Admin HIDING Records on Its Abuse of Trump [INSIDE JW] Judicial Watch Files Two New FOIA Lawsuits for Records on Biden Raid on Trump Home [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28202&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9oUVF6OXNsRHd2VT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=] We’re in court again to uncover more details of the Biden operation’s decision-making leading up to its unconscionable raid on President Trump’s Florida home. We filed two FOIA suits against the Justice Department for FBI and DOJ records of the Mar-a-Lago raid search warrant application and approval, as well as communications about the warrant between the FBI, Executive Office of the President and the Secret Service. We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the DOJ failed to respond to August 2022 FOIA requests. The first complaint asks for all records documenting the application, authorization and communications related to the execution of a search warrant at the residence of President Trump on August 8, 2022 (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28182&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRydW1wLXdhcnJhbnQtYXBwLWF1dGhvcml6YXRpb24tY29tcGxhaW50LTAyODg0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]) (No. 1:22-cv-02884)). Additionally, we are suing for all records of meetings or phone calls between Director Wray, Deputy Director Abbate, Associate Deputy Director Turner, Associate Deputy Director Sallet, and/or Chief of Staff Lenzner pertaining to the search warrant. We also requested communications between the FBI and the Executive Office of the President and/or the Secret Service regarding the search warrant (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28183&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRydW1wLXdhcnJhbnQtZGlzY3Vzc2lvbnMtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyODgzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]) (No. 1:22-cv-02883)). We are at the forefront of the court battle for transparency regarding the abusive Biden raid on Trump’s home. In August, we forced the release [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=27949&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdHJ1bXAtcmFpZC1hZmZpZGF2aXQtcmVsZWFzZWQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==] of the raid affidavit. We also just sued [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=27955&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctbGF3c3VpdC1hZ2FpbnN0LWFyY2hpdmVzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=] the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) for records about its controversial targeting of former President Trump over this records dispute. The American people have a right to know the entire story about the Biden administration’s abusive raid on President Trump’s home. The raid on President Trump’s home was an outrageous, reckless, and unprecedented abuse of power – and the unlawful Biden agency secrecy about the raid only adds to the scandal. JUDICIAL WATCH SUES CALIFORNIA SEC OF STATE FOR CAUSING YOUTUBE TO CENSOR KEY ELECTION INTEGRITY VIDEO JUST BEFORE 2020 ELECTION Our country works only if we have clean elections, and we suffer if the government imposes restraints on the exposure of less than fair voting. That happened in California – to us. But it’s the voters who deserve redress. We filed a lawsuit against the Secretary of State of the State of California for having YouTube censor a Judicial Watch election integrity video (_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. Shirley Weber, in her official capacity as Secretary of State of the State of California_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28190&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtd2ViZXIteW91dHViZS1jb21wbGFpbnQtNjg5NC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE] (No. 2:22-cv-6894)). We sued in the U.S. District Court Central District of California Western Division. Our suit states that the California Office of Elections Cybersecurity (OEC), which Secretary of State Shirley Weber oversees, caused YouTube to remove our election integrity video on September 25, 2020. We allege that the California official and her office violated our First Amendment and other civil rights. As we explain to the court, we have posted more than 4,200 videos on our YouTube channel since 2006 and they have received nearly 94 million views. Our channel has more than 502,000 subscribers. Because of the state’s action, the video in question received only 5,531 views. We ask the court to declare the state's actions to be unconstitutional and permanently enjoin it from violating our constitutional rights and unconstitutionally regulating our speech. Here’s the story. On September 22, 2020, we posted on our YouTube channel a video titled “**ELECTION INTEGRITY CRISIS** Dirty Voter Rolls, Ballot Harvesting & Mail-in-Voting Risks! [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28191&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly92aW1lby5jb20vNDYyMDE0MDI3XeKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q= The 26-minute video featured me discussing the vote-by-mail processes, changes to states’ election procedures, ballot collection (sometimes referred to as “ballot harvesting”), and states’ failures to clean up their voter rolls, among other topics. The complaint states that my comments were informed by successful lawsuits we brought against Los Angeles County and Weber in 2017 to compel the county and state to comply with the National Voter Registration Act’s (NVRA [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=435&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3YvY3J0L25hdGlvbmFsLXZvdGVyLXJlZ2lzdHJhdGlvbi1hY3QtMTk5My1udnJhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]) voter list maintenance requirements. For instance, in June 2019 [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28192&F=T&], we were informed that Los Angeles County had sent notices to 1.6 million inactive voters on its voter rolls after a settlement agreement had been reached. Prior to the California settlement agreement [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=14293&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS90YWcvbG9nYW4tc2V0dGxlbWVudC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE], we estimated that national census data and voter-roll information showed that there were 3.5 million [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=10666&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9MeklxU2RXSUtGbz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=] more names on various county voter rolls nationwide than there were citizens of voting age [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=4910&F=T&]. Records show the Office of Elections Cybersecurity communicated with YouTube and/or Google to have our video taken down [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28194&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2Etc3RhdGUtb2ZmaWNpYWxzLWJpZy10ZWNoLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]. On September 24, 2020, OEC Social Media Coordinator Akilah Jones emailed “civics-outreach@google.com [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28203&F=T&drurl=aHR0cDovL21haWx0bzpjaXZpY3Mtb3V0cmVhY2hAZ29vZ2xlLmNvbV3igJ0/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE and copied four YouTube employees with the subject line, “REPORT VIDEO: **ELECTION INTEGRITY CRISIS** Dirty Voter Rolls, Ballot Harvesting & Mail-in-Voting Risks!” In the email, Jones wrote: Hi YouTube Reporting Team, I am reporting the following video because it misleads community members about elections or other civic processes and misrepresents the safety and security of mail-in ballots. Thank you for your time and attention on this matter. All the best, Akilah. At or about 11:16 a.m. (ET) on September 25, 2020, YouTube and/or Google representative Andrea Holtermann replied to Jones: Hi Akilah, Thanks for reaching out. We will look into this and get back to you as soon as we can. Later that same day, we noticed that the video had been taken down. On September 27, 2020, YouTube and/or Google’s Holtermann confirmed to Jones that Judicial Watch’s video had been removed: Hi Akilah, Circling back on this. Thank you for raising this content to our attention, this has been removed from the platform for violating our policies. Please do not hesitate to reach out if there are any other questions or concerns you may have. Our complaint establishes that the actions of Weber and OEC violated our First and Fourteen Amendment rights, as well as civil rights violations under the California constitution. Smoking gun documents show California government officials, who were being advised by the Biden campaign PR operation, caused YouTube to censor a key Judicial Watch video just before the 2020 election. This egregious government censorship and election interference violated our civil rights, and our lawsuit seeks to stop and expose the growing corruption of leftist government officials colluding with Big Tech allies to attack the free speech rights of Americans. JUDICIAL WATCH SUES ON BEHALF OF CONCERNED MILITARY GROUP FOR AIR FORCE ACADEMY CRITICAL RACE THEORY RECORDS Judicial Watch is a national leader in exposing (and trying to stop) the intrusion of Marxist propaganda in our military academies. In June, we received [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=27536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY3J0LXByb3BhZ2FuZGEtYXQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE] records revealing critical race theory instruction at the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. In July we sued [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=27741&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctc3Vlcy1mb3ItbmF2YWwtYWNhZGVteS1jcnQtcmVjb3Jkcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE] the Defense Department for records related to the United States Naval Academy implementing critical race theory in the training of naval recruits. Thankfully, we’re not the only ones who are concerned. A group that included retired and distinguished military officers have noticed what is happening to their academies. We’re honored to assist them and get the truth. Judicial Watch just filed a FOIA suit on behalf of Stand Together Against Racism and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. (STARRS) against the Defense Department for U.S. Air Force Academy (USAFA) records regarding “systemic racism,” as well as records of critical race theory at the academy (_Stand Together Against Racism and Radicalism in the Services, Inc. v U.S. Department of Defense_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28188&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3N0YXJycy12LWRvZC1haXItZm9yY2UtYWNhZGVteS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI4OTQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==] (No. 1:22-cv-02894)). We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the Air Force refused to respond adequately to two FOIA requests about its race theory materials. In our complaint we explained to the court that STARRS asked for records relating to a July 8, 2020, memorandum issued by the USAFA superintendent which stated, in part, that: “[s]ystemic racism exists in our society, and our USAFA community is not immune.” The memorandum also stated that there would be “an institutional assessment and review for biases within our policies, processes, practices, curriculum, and artifacts ... [that] will be used to make tangible, lasting changes, and to inform future actions.” Our lawsuit also seeks records about any CRT training of USAFA cadets. Founded by a group of distinguished retired military officers, STARRS is concerned about efforts to teach and implement aspects of CRT in U.S. military academies and throughout the U.S. Armed Forces. STARRS has grown to 2,932 members, including general officers, service academy graduates, retired and active-duty officers and enlisted, and concerned civilians (https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60462&L=28189&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3RhcnJzLnVzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=). According to U.S. Air Force retired Lieutenant General Rod Bishop, STARRS’ Chairman of the Board, and the STARRS leadership team, each of which served decades in uniform: “The USAFA’s superintendent’s claim of systemic racism at the Academy did not comport with our experience. Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of “man” and “woman,” the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women’s athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer—now going by the name Lia Thomas—to compete in women’s competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women’s 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women’s sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words “man” and “woman.” In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women’s sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now—there is no time to waste.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zeq7ef01drofqr949cdj9enpvp7gndm9lg1boahg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cdj68o34cjh2bs) **

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0889%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=7X4Ck3WuwkhmedIUYqaNrg&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45700%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uqLikbURZT02ZWKSAiH3Ag&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45701%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iHxaiq6Uk3sOMVXNfvangw&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45702%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xHgTkoULYK%2fgxUKtSFVNXQ&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45703%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TMCDG4UFe%2bOQl46acZRFuw&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45704%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8ytxMmU7XPaj%2b3LX5mvfRA&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45715%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=99gtMGyDFmug1%2fEcd4NX2w&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45716%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=q70pgMUhX28%2f%2fsz%2ffU4avQ&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45717%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kDck7x%2bCHJjxLmflooJvMA&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45718%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QD8hU90sYKGuGQFK29OS0g&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45719%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5p%2fxqxhFdqbSPaDyKxMXZw&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45710%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1RvxFoY6KmQJVIHeHpKL4Q&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45711%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5r%2feudoqVOzq7XuvwKMSmA&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45712%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OSUzSHVU%2f%2fwE1sss9rUXw&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45713%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vcJnXRdVt9Y6%2bfDwofaX8g&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45714%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5A542tHgE4m0LFTyj%2bSvcA&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45725%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G8Ph6LaiP3lVy5ulCaoG2g&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45726%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qj%2f653GwD5H5Cs4qgu%2fEPQ&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J0Y1xTlZpunN%2fjjtHS0BIA&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

First they infiltrated organizations like the National School Board Association with far left radicals. **(FROM THE TOP DOWN)** Then they flooded local school boards in counties across the country (even conservative small towns) with millions of dollars of funding for radical left wing school board candidates. **(FROM THE BOTTOM UP)** And now, they've almost completely taken over our schools...
---
* Our children are being taught Critical Race Theory which preaches that all white people are evil, and all people of color are victims of oppression, and that America was founded on RACISM!
* Teachers and administrators have been authorized to bold-faced LIE to parents about what their children are doing in school.
* Guidance counselors and school-appointed therapists are coaching kids children as early as elementary school into identifying as transgender or "nonbinary."

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456409:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456410:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456416:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61456417:Jb8Z5BVWN:m:1:3345639852:7F967AA7E4CD88B9356C70E7092A4C94:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

Thank you, Peter.

clean_body: Peter, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Peter.
