name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464497:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61464498:JuKe2ZVoN:m:1:3317145305:D937A1EF018AAA948FF2B3A9C902B61B:r)

clean_body: Peter, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Peter. name: Tina Kotek
subject: 38 days left!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:
|
#
---
Hey, everyone! **I want to start by saying _thank you_ for your support. Thanks to you, we accomplished more than we thought was possible in the last 30 days, so I wanted to share a quick update on three important fronts.** **We needed to hit our fundraising targets in September to counter the attack ads that my conservative opponents started running. Thanks to your support, we surpassed our monthly fundraising goal with nearly 10,000 grassroots donors supporting our campaign.** We also need to elevate the key issues in this race, so we held a gun violence prevention forum with Moms Demand Action, a roundtable on abortion rights with EMILY’s List, and a conversation about the future of Oregon with local high school students. Third, we had the first televised debate of the general election in Bend – and I went in feeling strong because I know we have the best team of supporters. The contrast in the race became very clear that night. While I shared my plans for tackling our state’s biggest challenges, my opponents were very light on details and proved that they are too right-wing when it comes to gun violence, climate change, and other critical issues. Now, it’s crunch time, Peter. clean_body: | Hey, everyone! I want to start by saying thank you for your support. Thanks to you, we accomplished more than we thought was possible in the last 30 days, so I wanted to share a quick update on three important fronts. We needed to hit our fundraising targets in September to counter the attack ads that my conservative opponents started running. Thanks to your support, we surpassed our monthly fundraising goal with nearly 10,000 grassroots donors supporting our campaign. We also need to elevate the key issues in this race, so we held a gun violence prevention forum with Moms Demand Action, a roundtable on abortion rights with EMILY’s List, and a conversation about the future of Oregon with local high school students. Third, we had the first televised debate of the general election in Bend – and I went in feeling strong because I know we have the best team of supporters. The contrast in the race became very clear that night. While I shared my plans for tackling our state’s biggest challenges, my opponents were very light on details and proved that they are too right-wing when it comes to gun violence, climate change, and other critical issues. Now, it’s crunch time, Peter. Ballots will be hitting mailboxes this month, and #TeamTina is working non-stop on the final push to reach voters and get out the vote. Together, we’re building this campaign on grassroots support, and this same people-driven organizing will help us finish strong. Thank you for your support in this work. I’m incredibly grateful to have you with me. Onward to November! — Tina | = Tina for Oregon PO Box 42307 Portland, OR 97242 | mailto:info@tinafororegon.com | | Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I want to tell you a story about the first time I visited the Governor’s
Mansion.

But first, [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221001_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=10396%2E1862389%2EPgDg8A ]will you invest $5 in my campaign right now
to build One Georgia, where we all thrive — and where our children are
safe and surrounded by opportunity and possibility? Your $5
donation could help take us right over the finish line today and help us
begin opening gates of opportunity across Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221001_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=10396%2E1862389%2EPgDg8A ]DONATE

In 1991, I graduated as the valedictorian of Avondale High School. Like
most Georgia valedictorians, I was invited to meet the Governor of Georgia
at the Governor’s Mansion.

It was a big deal for my family. That morning, I got up and put on my
Sunday best. My parents and I boarded the MARTA bus with the domestic
workers and mechanics who, like us, could not afford a car.

We took MARTA all the way from DeKalb County to Buckhead, got off at West
Paces Ferry Road, and walked up the long driveway to the big black gates
around the property. When we got to the guard station, the guard looked at
my parents, then he looked at me and said, “This is a private event, you
don’t belong here.”

He looked over our shoulder at the MARTA bus driving away and he told
himself a story about who would be on that bus — and in his story, they
did not belong in the Governor’s Mansion.

My parents pushed back and I got in. But looking back on that day, I don’t
remember meeting the Governor of Georgia. I don’t even remember
celebrating my accomplishments with valedictorians from 159 counties and
180 school districts. The only thing I remember is a man blocking the
gates of the most powerful place in Georgia, telling me that I did not
belong.

I have spent my life in public service opening the gates of opportunity
for those often left behind. But now, I need your help to change the face
of leadership in Georgia and win this election on November 8.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221001_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=10396%2E1862389%2EPgDg8A ]So, I’m humbly asking,
Derek: will you help show the
world that Georgia can be a state that works for all? Let’s show everyone
— Brian Kemp, the media and everyone else who counted us out — that we
have a mandate to open those gates and keep them open.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221001_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=10396%2E1862389%2EPgDg8A ]DONATE

body:
Hey Peter,
First, I want to say thank you to everyone who donated towards our end-of-quarter deadline. We got closer to our $50,000 goal than we ever thought possible, and we couldn't have gotten this far without our amazing grassroots army of supporters.
Unfortunately, we fell short this time and missed our goal by $2,817. I'm hoping that by being transparent with you all, you can help us fill the gap with this one email.
[_**Can you please donate now to help us reach our goal (even if it 's a day after)? name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: Omg, Derek ❤️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We mean it.
#
**Omg, Derek ❤️**
I know that we have been sending a lot of emails lately (sorry!), but I wanted to take a moment to share two things.
1️⃣ Thank you for being a supporter of this campaign. Your encouragement means the world to us.
2️⃣ Last night, just after midnight, João got the call from our HQ staff that we not only reached our end-of-quarter fundraising goal but surpassed it!!
This is exciting for a million reasons, but especially because of this:
**We're running a clean, kind and honest Democratic campaign.** I think kindness has long been missing in politics and we need to elect leaders who will change politics for good. We also believe not all money is good money... which is why we don’t take any money from dirty corporate PACs.
We’ve always funded our campaign this way — the right way — because when we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.
Derek, that’s why my family and I are so deeply grateful for all of this: Every supporter, every contribution, and every message of encouragement. Even just reading this email makes you a big part of this team.
We hope being a part of this campaign makes you proud.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)

| | | | | Peter, [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7ba05354-191c-4caf-8283-b309422b995e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **This week we saw all that plagues the Republican Party and because of them, our country, which I chronicled at my growing Youtube commentary channel,[The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T27e89dcd-068b-4a56-97ac-40d3b2b21ed9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). ** **First, with the damage wrought by Hurricane Ian, we were reminded that we can stick our heads in the sand or refuse to look up in the sky, but science is science, climate change is real and it'****s only getting worse (to all Floridians affected by Ian, please know that my thoughts are with you). Thankfully, with the Inflation Reduction Act, President Biden and Democrats made the largest investment in climate change prevention and mitigation in American history. I say Democrats, because, shamefully, NOT ONE REPUBLICAN VOTED FOR IT. ** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea052de1-4737-4ec4-9039-563d5e6accb9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **The enduring image may be Sharknado in Fort Myers. Yes, a shark was caught on video swimming down the streets of the Florida city. Much like with The Trump Era, sci-fi and horror films are becoming our reality. I[ discussed it in one of my videos](https://default.salsalabs.org/T711ec98a-ea8b-4bcb-9f1b-a0992360b08f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), reminding viewers that Republicans can reject science, whether due to greed, religious zealotry or just plain cruelty, but science will win in the end. [I hope you'll go watch](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9941d744-32c2-4d42-82d9-ffdd742bb9e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and then [subscribe to the The Takedown](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a3dc2db-ae90-47ea-b6dd-a31adb176419/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). ** **I also[took a look at an outlandish Republican](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7e2966e7-ac85-4f49-96f5-6446743c89ba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), Pennsylvania gubernatorial candidate Doug Mastriano, through the eyes of Stephen Colbert's mockery (with some of mine added in, I must admit). S****adly, this traitor--who was part of the attemped coup ****at the Capitol**** January 6th, thinks women should be prosecuted for murder for having an abortion, has been filmed in a Confederate Uniform (psst, someone give him a history lesson about which side Pennsylvania was on) and hired as a consultant the the founder of the awful neo-Nazi site Gab that inspired the Tree of Life Temple mass-murderer in Pittsburgh--is representative of most Republican statewide candidates across the country.** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T28e7d825-b14b-483b-ba35-ebfd0847fdf6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Thankfully, Mastriano's currently down by 10 points in the polls to PA Attorney General, Josh Shapiro. Which, led Stephen Colbert to list all I did in that last paragraph, and more, and sum up Mastriano in two words: "You Suuuuuck." I agreed with Colbert and added my own take on Mastriano's treachery, and how representative it is of the GOP overall. [I hope you'll go give it a watch](https://default.salsalabs.org/T52a44ca2-d9d3-4e2f-8ae0-fec65c2b1a29/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and also [subscribe to the channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta1048737-282e-4de6-9bc8-6aa13de8f926/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)!** **It is as sad as it is simple. Most mainstream media has proven unable to adjust to a world where one party--the Republican one--doesn't believe in governing, is thoroughly corrupt, in love with authoritarianism, thinks cruelty is a virtue and incompetence & ignorance are qualities to brag about. All they can do is "both sides" everything. Therefore [we must build our own media](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta1110d00-73dc-48dc-9411-17bccf2b5916/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). The more of you who [subscribe to The Takedown](https://default.salsalabs.org/T860ff3a9-1ac1-4da8-8e43-736164e51c36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), the more Youtube considers it worthy of promoting, increasing the impact we have on protecting our democracy. Plus, I think you'll really like it!** **So[PLEASE subscribe and start watching](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5daf4ed2-359a-4095-bca6-9889affaed25/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) so we can help mitigate the twin disasters of right wing media and both-sides mainstream media. It's another way we can contribute to keeping this republic, to paraphrase Ben Franklin, for the next generation. So one last time I ask you to [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta8a6a46b-d0e0-4593-870f-8b9ea2298d64/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)so we can get the truth out to the largest audience possible. THANK YOU.** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6c7b102c-8e9a-49bc-851e-353d9683ea54/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) All my best, Cliff

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: I am so grateful for you.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I’m reaching out simply to say thank you.
#
I wanted to reach out just to let you know that I am filled with gratitude. This team amazes me every single day.
So many folks like you stepped up to help us reach our goal before last night’s FEC deadline. We’re still adding up the numbers, but I think you will be very proud of what we accomplished when we report them publicly soon.
Thanks to everyone who contributed, we are in a strong position heading into the final 38 days.
The challenges ahead are steep, but I am more certain than ever that we can win this race.
It won’t be easy — far from it. Far-right super PACs are flooding millions more dollars into our state every single week. But what we have proven is that we are ready to fight for this seat — tirelessly. We won’t ignore the super PAC’s lies or my opponent’s extreme agenda. We’ll take them head-on and make the case to the people of North Carolina that we can win a brighter future where our rights, democracy and planet are protected — and that is what our families deserve.
My mom was granted the right to vote by the Voting Rights Act. She used to say that every election is the most important election of our lives. She was right. This November, our constitutional rights are on the line.
And I stand firm in my commitment that, when we win this race together, I will not hesitate to cast the decisive vote to end the filibuster and defend our democracy, planet, voting rights, and reproductive freedom.
That’s what is at stake this fall, and this year, we are going to deliver and give our families a voice in the Senate. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for all you are doing.
Onward to victory,
Cheri Beasley
If you didn’t have a chance to contribute last month, will you chip in today to help us start the final stretch strong? We only have 38 days until Election Day — and early voting starts even sooner, so this is important.
[**Please consider making a donation to our campaign today. North Carolina is one of Democrats’ best chances to flip a seat, and right now, our race is in a statistical tie.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221001-2-MA&t=2&akid=1916%2E357359%2EUwP3EX)

Cheri Beasley for North Carolina

Raleigh, NC 27611

Friend,

I want to tell you an important story today, but before I do: [**Would you consider donating to my campaign for U.S. Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51770632/370319987/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4564-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTRjM2QxNS1lMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jnNh52e3MAI_ytMiBDE6Vsq_A6mJH-wKV6ZEOWUPy0U=) As a young girl, I could never have imagined that I'd become a congresswoman and one day run for U.S. Senate, but my parents believed in me and did everything they could to ensure I had a bright future. I'd be so honored to have your support, too.
**Now, let me tell you a story:** I remember in seventh grade, my class was going on a big trip to Washington, D.C. My dad, a janitor who worked seven days a week to make ends meet for our family, asked for an advance to pay for my plane ticket. I'm still amazed today he could find the money – and I'm touched that he sacrificed so much for me.
That first trip to Washington, D.C., made a major impact on me. I stood at the feet of Lincoln's statue in the Lincoln Memorial, gazing up at this giant of American history. I walked through the Library of Congress with wide eyes. I looked at the U.S. Capitol in awe, totally unaware that one day I'd have the opportunity to work in that very building.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51770633/370319988/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4564-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTRjM2QxNS1lMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jnNh52e3MAI_ytMiBDE6Vsq_A6mJH-wKV6ZEOWUPy0U=)
If my parents could see me today, they would be so proud of everything I've been able to accomplish. I truly believe that only in America can a little Black girl growing up in the South in the 1960s have such an amazing story of opportunity.
But the truth is, my story is a rare one. For so many working families like mine, the American dream is simply out of reach. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate to expand my story of opportunity to more Americans – by reducing student debt, raising the minimum wage, expanding access to child care and cutting health care costs.
If you're with me, I need your support right now. I'm neck and neck with Marco Rubio in this close race. If we flip Florida blue, Democrats could expand our Senate majority and pass our agenda, so I have to ask: **[Will you donate $5 right now to help me push ahead, win this race and provide more opportunities for working families?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51770634/370319989/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4564-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTRjM2QxNS1lMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jnNh52e3MAI_ytMiBDE6Vsq_A6mJH-wKV6ZEOWUPy0U=)**
Thanks for being part of this historic grassroots movement.

Congresswoman Val Demings

My dad, a janitor who worked seven days a week to make ends meet for our family, asked for an advance to pay for my plane ticket. I'm still amazed today he could find the money – and I'm touched that he sacrificed so much for me. That first trip to Washington, D.C., made a major impact on me. I stood at the feet of Lincoln's statue in the Lincoln Memorial, gazing up at this giant of American history. I walked through the Library of Congress with wide eyes. I looked at the U.S. Capitol in awe, totally unaware that one day I'd have the opportunity to work in that very building. = If my parents could see me today, they would be so proud of everything I've been able to accomplish. I truly believe that only in America can a little Black girl growing up in the South in the 1960s have such an amazing story of opportunity. But the truth is, my story is a rare one. For so many working families like mine, the American dream is simply out of reach. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate to expand my story of opportunity to more Americans – by reducing student debt, raising the minimum wage, expanding access to child care and cutting health care costs. If you're with me, I need your support right now. I'm neck and neck with Marco Rubio in this close race. If we flip Florida blue, Democrats could expand our Senate majority and pass our agenda, so I have to ask: = Thanks for being part of this historic grassroots movement. Congresswoman Val Demings | | Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate.
